One of your routines is firing right now, on its schedule, and this is that firing.

Name three houseplants that grow well in low light, one short line each, no formatting.

response.content:
Snake plant — tough, upright, and tolerant of very low light.
ZZ plant — glossy-leaved and exceptionally forgiving in dim rooms.
Cast-iron plant — slow-growing, hardy, and well suited to shade.
